title: RoboVision 3.0 solution package
subtitle: README, deterministic solver notebook and LB 0.860 submission
description: Solution for RoboVision Challenge - DataHack 3.0. Actions are x_pick,y_pick,x_place,y_place; metric is exp(-(d/0.05)^2) per action. Place coordinates are a per-(task,step) lookup (exact). Pick coordinates come from a deterministic scene parser: 3 colour pairs x 2 shapes, intensity-sorted, back-projected onto the table plane; ImageNet EfficientNet-B0 with mirror augmentation is the fallback. Public LB 0.86025.
